title: monoidal-category
description: A category equipped with a tensor product ⊗ : C × C → C, a unit object I, and coherence isomorphisms for associativity and units satisfying the pentagon and triangle. The many-object generalization of a monoid; the base over which enriched categories take their hom-objects. A category refined by a coherent tensor.

tensor.description: the tensor product ⊗ : C × C → C

unit.description: the unit object I, neutral for ⊗

coherence.description: associator and unitor isomorphisms satisfy the pentagon and triangle identities
